_comment: Laptop-only dev: frames from disk -> marker detection (always on, the PRIMARY detector; marker_backend 'aruco'|'qr') -> sightings.csv. 0 drones, no flight. YOLO is OFF by default; to exercise it set detector backend 'ultralytics' + weights (best.pt = qualifier barrel model, plumbing only). replay_fps 5 = 2 sample chances per frame at the 10 Hz sample rate, robust by default.
